scope: Five verified 2021–2025 and four verified 2014–2017 champions, all linked to user-confirmed stable franchises. For 2015, ESPN's recorded Week 16 final determines the champion under the user's ruling; archived semifinal advancement discrepancy is preserved.

rules.marker: One trophy for a verified title-winning franchise, displaying years and a title count when needed.
rules.historical_aliases: Resolve by (season, ESPN source league ID, ESPN team ID), then anonymous permanent franchise ID.
rules.unknown_titles: No trophy for unverified seasons or placement games; historic aliases show trophies only for the season they won.
rules.owner_privacy: Store no owner or manager identifiers.
rules.legacy_season_markers: 2014–2017 title trophies credited to user-confirmed franchises. In 2015 the recorded ESPN final winner is authoritative despite the preserved inconsistent semifinal progression; original-era aliases receive a trophy in the season won and current franchises receive cumulative verified titles.
rules.recorded_final_2015: Use exactly the two ESPN-recorded Week 16 championship finalists and the ESPN final's winner/points to award 2015: The General's "Dorm Room" (ESPN team 2, 173.62) beats Pokerwithmy Fleener (ESPN team 9, 88.20). Preserve the semifinal advancement discrepancy without fabricating a correction; do not claim bracket progression was reconciled.

legacy_champions.confirmation_basis: ESPN Week 16 winners-bracket final matchup 75; HOME 173.62 vs AWAY 88.20; user directs recorded finalists and final winner are authoritative
